description: Merge two or more contact lists into a single unified list, deduplicating entries. Window merge creates a virtual union; materialized merge creates a static copy.

mergeType.description: Merge strategy: 'window' (virtual union, stays in sync) or 'materialized' (static copy at merge time)

name.description: Display name for the resulting merged list

slug.description: URL-friendly slug for the merged list (auto-generated if omitted)

sourceListIds.description: UUIDs or slugs of the source lists to merge (minimum 2)

name: neuron_merge_contact_lists
